title: Payload — moderation.label_created
$comment: A verdict, publishable by anyone — authority comes from who follows the signer. There is no action field: a label says what something IS, never what to do about it. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
